harness: python3 -m py_compile tools/netns_adversarial_probe.py && bash tools/netns_adversarial_probe.sh target/debug/outbound-guard-mcp target/debug/examples/cancel_fetch_probe
fixture: Route-free Linux namespace; ephemeral trusted CA; tls-handshake.test resolves first to 11.0.0.2 with wrong-host leaf and then to 11.0.0.1 with matching leaf; next DNS A lookup returns private 127.0.0.1
scope: Certificate hostname validation failure on the first pinned TLS endpoint stops the request without trying a second approved address; a private next-call DNS answer is denied and same-process recovery succeeds.
limits: This single fixture does not cover all TLS alerts, incomplete handshakes, or reconnect after an established connection.
It tests one Linux resolver and MCP process, not every platform or traffic sent through other tools.
